name: What preparations should I make before kitchen cabinet removal?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before kitchen cabinet removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before kitchen cabinet removal, it is important to clear the kitchen area. This includes emptying all cabinet contents, removing items from countertops, and safeguarding any appliances not being removed. We also recommend protecting adjacent rooms and pathways with drop cloths to contain dust and debris. If any plumbing or electrical work is integrated into the cabinetry, ensure these are safely disconnected or noted for our team to handle with care.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before removal, clear all cabinet contents and countertops, protect adjacent areas, and ensure any integrated plumbing or electrical is safely managed.
